THE FREIGHT LIST walking medicine alone then an honest empty pack

KEEP THE BEAT walking on at 100% and COME IN walking them to the fire with the mail

the wedge card with both moods, a painted glyph, put away and kept, the tab, the rail, the cap
the hint strip in your keys; the lessons; the save
The registry (12g_muster.js) adds seven WORK_ORDERS rows and names, per job, which rows it walks under

figure.note: the seven v3.37 rows stand, each with its choices and lines (the table holds ten since v3.38's three post rows)

clauses.text: FIELD.hauler → THE LOAD + the freight list; FIELD.presser → THE MARKS; FIELD.mason → THE RESERVE; FIELD.forrester → THE REACH + THE WOODS; ROAD → THE RUN + THE PACE + the freight list.
THE FREIGHT LIST is a third policy tree (verb `haul`, rooted on `freight`, default: every trade good ON, the post OFF)

`ordersOf` seeds a tree's registry default into a store only when that tree has NO mark at all in it — every mark the store already holds stands, the working rows take their defaults, and the pack's ledger is untouched.
THE FREIGHT LIST gates a hauler's arrival: of what THIS town needs, only what is on the list; the emptiest allowed shelf first, what the other end makes preferred.
Nothing on the list that the town wants → the pack arrives EMPTY, the roll says so in the walker's words and a toast says it once — an honest empty pack, not a silent one.
THE LOAD: full is one good to the cap; split is two goods, half each, so two shelves climb at once.

figure.note: split walks exactly half the cap of tools and half of medicine into Elm Farm, the third shelf untouched

clauses.text: a presser's clicked point is the first of a CHAIN — ADD A MARK on the roll arms the ground and the next click appends
STRIKE takes the last mark, never the first
At every end the presser MEASURES the trail
THE REACH: far searches nearly twice the radius for standing wood.

figure.note: the row reads ×1.9; at Pharos the far axe walks past the near radius and within 1.9 of it

clauses.text: THE WOODS: thin keeps every other tree — after a fell, the next tree the axe would take is KEPT by cell index, for good, and the one past it falls; the wood stands, thinner.
THE RUN on a charter: the post pays appreciation at both ends as before; freight walks a crate from the freight list onto the emptiest shelf of the ends in turn for half the thanks.

figure.note: a freight run's thanks at its end are the post run's halved (rounded), and the row reads 0.5

clauses.text: THE PACE: hard comes round in seven tenths of the time and eats twice for it.

figure.record: seven tenths of the time and eats twice
figure.note: hard: the next run at 0.7 of the steady interval (to 0.02 s) and a whole provision against half

clauses.text: Summed live from causes the game already tracks
a fresh hire reading STEADY at nought
The band DOES something: BRIGHT steadies your pack × 1.3 and reaches × 1.15; LOW × 0.7 and × 0.85; DONE × 0.5 and × 0.7.

figure.note: the effects read 1.3/1.15 at BRIGHT, 0.7/0.85 at LOW, 0.5/0.7 at DONE

clauses.text: A band change is said on the ground in the walker's own lines
a companion DONE for a minute beside a lit town SITS DOWN: off the party, into the pool at that fire, the cargo racked in the lockers, a mail naming every cause, re-hirable when it lifts

figure.note: sat down between 60 and 66 s of DONE

The hint strip prints the caps KEYS holds now — rebind map to N in the manual and the strip reads N beside map at once; reset and it reads M.
